title: Gist Artifact manifest
description: The artifact.json file of a Gist Artifact, version 0.1. The specification text is authoritative where it and this schema disagree.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema that describes this manifest.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Gist Artifacts specification the manifest was written for.

title.description: Human-readable title of the artifact. Plain text on a single line.

entrypoint.description: Exact name of the content file to present first.

mediaType.description: Media type of the entrypoint, optionally with parameters.

description.description: One-sentence summary of the artifact. Plain text.

icon.description: One generic word suggesting a pictogram, such as chart, map or notes.

generator.description: Name of the software that produced the artifact, optionally with its version.

source.description: Absolute URL of the code, commit or dataset the artifact was produced from.
